crossRefs.note: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.
translations.bsb: So Ruth stayed close to the servant girls of Boaz to glean grain until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
translations.kjv: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
translations.asv: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz, to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.
